points.text: ECI announced the **SSR** of electoral rolls for **6** States/UTs (Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim, Chandigarh, DNH&DD) where SIR is complete — draft rolls **30 Nov**, final **21 Jan 2027**; Aadhaar stays voluntary.
Activists demanded FIRs over alleged **Form 7 forgery** in Delhi's Mustafabad; **₹47.56 lakh** names were dropped from Delhi's draft roll; final roll deadline pushed to **22 December**.
ECI restored oversight of its **IT wing** (headed by Seema Khanna) under a Deputy Election Commissioner, reversing a July order, after ECs S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi objected.

SC (Justice **Ujjal Bhuyan**): **arrest begins** the moment an official **touches** a person to restrain liberty — starts the **24-hour** clock then; held **beyond 24 hours** must be freed, detention time recorded.
An **unauthorised** 3-storey building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's **Chawri Bazar**, killing 2 — Delhi's **3rd** major building collapse since 6 September.
**859** sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025); SC's *Dr. Balram Singh* (2023) raised death compensation to **₹30 lakh** per worker.
DRDO successfully flight-tested the indigenous quasi-ballistic missile **Pralay** from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha, clearing the way for its induction into the armed forces.

Govt clarified **Agnipath is not rolled back**: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before; the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement before joining the regular cadre with **protected seniority**.

CERT-In named China-linked hacking group **'Crafty Falcon'**, which used AI tools (ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI) to breach Indian non-bank lenders, fintechs and crypto exchanges 'at machine speed'.
NPCI told the SC **'zero MDR' on UPI is unsustainable**; the new **0.4% MDR** applies only to Person-to-Merchant transactions **above ₹2,000** — P2P and small P2M stay free.

**CERT-In** issued 'AI Security Auditing Guidelines' for **agentic AI** systems that plan tasks and delegate work on their own, calling for audits of permission overreach and emergency 'stop' mechanisms.
ISRO chief V. Narayanan confirmed navigation satellite **NVS-03** (launched 30 Oct) is 'fully healthy' after its engine fired for **6,400 seconds** to reach circular orbit.
NPPA capped trade margins at **30%** on **137** non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices of nearly **900** brands by **70-93%**; but **194 of 1,024** analysed brands saw **no** price cut.
A *Nature Medicine* global study of **6.1 million** people in 118 countries found women report more pain than men at **all 11** body sites studied — **83%** higher for facial pain.

A **tokamak** confines fusion plasma using **magnetic fields** in a ring shape; **ITER** (7 members incl. India) is being built at **Cadarache, France**; India's tokamaks are **ADITYA/ADITYA-U** and **SST-1** at Gandhinagar.

Centre told the SC it is weighing a panel to review the **UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026**, stayed by the SC in **January 2026** as 'too sweeping'; the older 2012 Regulations continue to apply.
Census 2027 will be India's **first fully digital Census**; door-to-door count begins **1 December** in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa, tracked via the **CMMS** app.

Israel's Arab-majority **Joint List** and **Ra'am** backed **Gadi Eisenkot** (not PM Netanyahu) to form the next government after the inconclusive 27 Oct election; President **Isaac Herzog** gives the mandate.
Iran reported two more tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the **Strait of Hormuz**; UKMTO reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.

On US midterm day, President **Trump** announced the US will stop its roughly **$4-billion** annual military aid to Israel by year-end, citing political costs after a candidate's anti-aid stance helped flip Michigan.
US VP **J.D. Vance** blamed the **Iran war** for the Republican midterm defeat, positioning himself as front-runner for the **2028** Republican presidential nomination.
India beat Japan **4-1** in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey final in Mohali to retain the title — its **6th ACT crown in 7 editions**; Hardik Singh played his **200th** international match.
**Cristiano Ronaldo** (41) retired from international football as Portugal's all-time (world-record) scorer with **146 goals in 234 matches**.
Delhi-Services Ranji Group-C match ended in a draw: Rajat Paliwal (116) and Mohit Ahlawat (142) powered Services; Yash Dhull (104*) rescued Delhi chasing 320 in 54 overs.
**Chennai Super Kings** traded for Liam Livingstone and Jack Edwards from Sunrisers Hyderabad, giving up Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis, ahead of IPL 2027 — CSK's first trade under coach Zaheer Khan.
